Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent to burn or reckless disregard of an obvious fire risk); forgetting to turn off the stove is mere negligence, so the defendant is not guilty.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle consists of two named phases, diastole and systole; contraction and relaxation describe those phases, and there is no separate rest phase.

Q8294.reason: Hydrogen bonds hold ice in an open crystalline lattice of lower density than liquid water, so higher pressure favors the denser liquid and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
